path.description: Mega-MoE kernel (dispatch + grouped GEMM + combine in one persistent kernel): per-expert token counts in shared memory (atomicAdd_block, lines 316 and 332), cross-rank send/recv counts (atomic_add / atomic_add_sys at 325, 354), and ring-buffer full/empty counters (red_add at 534, 973-984). The fp8/fp4 twin has the same structure (sm100_fp8_fp4_mega_moe.cuh:359-1136).

downstream.argument: The counters place tokens into expert buffers and gate ring-buffer stages. The expert GEMM computes rows independently, and the combine side of this kernel was not read line by line; whether the per-token combine sums experts in a fixed order or in ring-arrival order is not established here.
